Verification recomputes the chain and checks every caveat

div.div: Why support all three? The thesis question is which fits a dynamic continuum. A single PEP with three authenticators keeps everything else equal, so differences in latency, CPU and revocation window come from the credential alone. The production answer is likely a mix: mTLS between services, capabilities for delegated tasks, tokens for humans.

text.tspan: Why support all three? The thesis question is which fits a dynamic continuum. A single PEP with three authenticators keeps everything else equal, so differences in latency, CPU and revocation window come from the credential alone. The production
answer is likely a mix: mTLS between services, capabilities for delegated tasks, tokens for humans.
